description: Category 1 (numerical) questions with integer answers, authored from the challenge sample questions and reference images in questions/arabic_room/questions.pdf. Objects are restricted to salient, visually verifiable furniture and decor so a human can confirm every answer from the scene. Answers are cross-checked against the iref_vla object bounding boxes via scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2_arabic_room.py.
notes: Q01 is the official Category 1 sample question from questions/arabic_room/questions.pdf; its answer (2) is the answer printed in the PDF.
difficulty: easy = single salient object class; medium = one relation or one color attribute; hard = two chained relations.

Only large, unambiguous objects are counted. Glasses, hookah wire, focus lights and structural classes (wall/floor/ceiling) are deliberately excluded because they are too small or too abstract to ground reliably.
The room is a majlis with three bench sofas in a U shape against the east half; two octagonal tea tables stand on the carpet enclosed by that U.
'Below a window' means the sofa footprint lies under one of the carved wooden window screens; two of the three sofas qualify.
The balcony is the region beyond the arched openings on the north side; it holds three potted plants, while two more potted plants stand inside the room.
object_ids lists supporting iref_vla scene-graph ids for auditing; SAM3 should use target_objects.

questions.question: How many sofas are below a window?
questions.evidence: Sofa 40 sits under window 20 on the south wall and sofa 74 sits under window 75 on the east wall; sofa 56 on the north side has no window above it.

questions.question: How many sofas are in the room?
questions.evidence: Three bench sofas form a U shape: south (40), east (74) and north (56).

questions.question: How many carpets are on the floor?
questions.evidence: One carpet is enclosed by the sofas (32) and one lies in front of the large wooden door (58).

questions.question: How many columns are in the room?
questions.evidence: Two round plaster columns stand in the middle of the room (23, 30).

questions.question: How many stools are in the room?
questions.evidence: One stool stands under a framed picture on the west wall (34) and one against the south wall with a book on it (63).

questions.question: How many wooden tea tables are on the carpet enclosed by the sofas?
questions.evidence: Both octagonal tea tables (28 with the hookah, 64 with the tray) stand on carpet 32 inside the sofa U.

questions.question: How many potted plants are on the balcony?
questions.evidence: Three potted plants stand on the balcony beyond the arches (53, 55, 83); potted plants 0 and 18 are inside the room and are not counted.

questions.question: How many gray pillows are on the sofas?
questions.evidence: Each of the three sofas carries exactly one gray patterned pillow: 2 on sofa 40, 52 on sofa 56, 7 on sofa 74. The remaining nine pillows are red.

questions.question: How many lanterns are mounted on the walls?
questions.evidence: Four stained-glass lanterns are fixed to the walls (26, 54 on the north wall; 57, 79 on the south wall). The two lanterns hanging from the ceiling and the two on the balcony floor are not wall mounted.

questions.question: How many red pillows are on the two sofas that are below a window?
questions.evidence: Sofa 40 (under window 20) has red pillows 13, 27, 73 and sofa 74 (under window 75) has red pillows 50, 70, 78; the gray pillow on each of those sofas is excluded.
